CVE-2026-134044.title: Open Robotics ROS 2 sros2 load_policy XML External Entity Process ...
CVE-2026-134044.description:
Open Robotics ROS 2 sros2 load_policy XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Open Robotics ROS 2. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of policy XML files. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-32121.

CVE-2026-134045.title: Open Robotics RViz PointCloud2Display PointField Out-of-Bounds Re ...
CVE-2026-134045.description:
Open Robotics RViz PointCloud2Display PointField Out-of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Open Robotics RViz. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of PointCloud2 messages. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-32123.

CVE-2026-134052.title: Open Robotics RViz fillIndexBuffer Heap-based Buffer Overflow Rem ...
CVE-2026-134052.description:
Open Robotics RViz fillIndexBuffer Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Open Robotics RViz. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of mesh resources in PointCloud and Marker displays. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-32652.
